defects: NOT CLOSED: post-CTS SS setup -2,032 ps / FF hold -882 ps. Cause is structural, not a CTS knob: register sinks span the whole 1.35 mm tile around four 515 x 563 um macros (pin registers on all four faces, ck pin at the top-right corner), and the quads' result pins (oy) sit on their outer edges and top/bottom, so stage registers land across macros with unbufferable over-macro wires (pre-CTS 3.5 ns arrival quad oy -> u_rl stage 0). Needs explicit channel placement of the pipeline banks (or the owner's two-strip tile, wt-hbm-attn) before a route can close.
